title: All 1,380 tick hashes across five goldens replaced wholesale with no in-chunk justification
detail: Every hash changed in every file; only the catalog_hash bump hints why. The diff cannot distinguish intended catalog-driven churn from a behavior regression silently re-blessed.
recommended_fix: Justify the re-bless against the code change that altered the catalog; regenerate via the official tool, not hand edits, and state expected full churn in the PR.

title: Shared old catalog_hash implies a suite-wide catalog, but only five goldens re-blessed
detail: All five files shared catalog_hash 66c4324a06058860 before this change, implying one catalog across demos. The diff shows no proof the re-bless set is complete.
recommended_fix: Search goldens for the old catalog_hash 66c4324a06058860 and re-bless or delete every remaining stale file in this same PR.

title: Hunk header line counts contradict hunk body counts in all five files
detail: Headers claim 305/245 lines per side, but each body holds 306/246 (four context lines, catalog_hash, ticks header, plus 300/240 tick lines). Uniform off-by-one on both sides.
recommended_fix: Regenerate the diff chunk with a correct tool; verify the underlying golden files were not truncated by one line.

title: Stray blank line inside qos_contention hunk, absent from the other four files
detail: Only qos_contention shows a blank line between the removal and addition blocks; the other four files transition directly (e.g., -300 32de90158da0d44d then +1 06dd55e5750d2283).
recommended_fix: Re-diff qos_contention.t1 and confirm no unintended blank line or newline-at-EOF difference was introduced into the golden.
